absent: Register offsets and bit meanings for PL011 status, data and control beyond flag names shown.
Actions of PL011 console setup, exit, match, atomic write and threaded write handlers.
DMA lifecycle, RS485 configuration and transmit timer callbacks for PL011 ports.
Contents of vendor descriptors, fifo sizing and modem control preservation rationale.
Power operations table, clock effects and uart suspend resume port mechanics.
Virtio transport operations for status, features, finalization and config change delivery.
Contracts for virtio driver validate, probe and scan callbacks beyond invocation order.
Population of debug filter bits and conditions triggering memory access checks.

findings.text: Console device lock and unlock operate on the global port table entry selected by the console index, applying the port irq saving discipline and restoring the saved flags on unlock.

The AMA console descriptor links the uart driver record, uses an unassigned index, enables printbuffer plus anytime plus nonblocking behaviour, advertises the AMA tty name, and binds handlers for device lookup, setup, teardown, matching, atomic write, threaded write and device locking.

Early transmit helpers poll a status flag until space is available, store one character with a width appropriate accessor, then poll until the transfer completes, with one quirk variant using a fixed wide accessor and empty completion indication while the standard helper adapts width and waits for idle.

Early output forwards a buffer through a shared console writer using the port specific emitter, while early input repeatedly samples the receiver, copies bytes up to the caller limit, stops when empty is signalled and reports how many were stored.

Early console setup rejects an unmapped port, installs output and possibly input hooks, and for the full device preserves modem outputs while enabling controller, receiver and transmitter with width appropriate access, whereas the generic variant only installs hooks, the quirk variant installs its own output hook, and alternate builds disable input or the whole console.

The uart driver record identifies the AMA family with its major and minor numbers, port count and console linkage, and the RS485 capability advertises enable plus RTS on send plus RTS after send plus receive during transmit with unit delays before and after.

Alias handling prefers the firmware serial number when present, in range and free, otherwise keeps probe order, remembers whether aliased and non aliased nodes appeared, and warns when a request is unavailable or when mixed enumeration risks unpredictability.

Port table lifecycle finds an empty slot, maps registers, resolves firmware alias, populates device state and publishes the entry, then on registration masks and clears interrupts, registers the driver once and adds the port with rollback on failure, while unregistration clears the entry, removes DMA state and unregisters the driver when idle.

AMBA probing negotiates a free slot and required resources, derives register layout, fifo depth and access width from vendor data subject to firmware override, prepares operations, RS485 support, identity and timers, then publishes through setup and registration, aborting on busy table, allocation, clock, mode or width errors.

Power handling suspends the port before gating its clock only when console suspend is allowed and the suspended console port is registered, resumes by enabling the clock under the same condition before resuming the port with rollback on failure, and rejects missing driver state.
Quirk handling swaps the vendor descriptor to the erratum variant with an informational notice when a global presence flag is set, while the alternate build provides an empty hook.

SBSA probing derives baud from firmware with a fixed fallback, claims a slot and interrupt, applies the erratum hook, uses a fixed fifo depth with SBSA operations and fixed baud, then maps, binds and registers, with removal detaching the port and releasing the table entry.

SBSA matching uses OF compatible arm,sbsa-uart and ACPI ARMH0011 plus ARMHB000 with platform driver name sbsa-uart, PL011 AMBA matching uses 0x00041011 mask 0x000fffff for ARM and 0x00380802 mask 0x00ffffff for ST and 0x0006b011 mask 0x000fffff for NVIDIA and 0x0008c011 mask 0x000fffff for ZTE with AMBA driver name uart-pl011, and console and uart names use ttyAMA.

Driver glue binds probe, remove, power and firmware tables for both platform and AMBA forms, suppresses bind attributes when builtin, registers the platform driver before the AMBA driver at init with a warning on platform failure, reverses at exit, and delegates driver data access to generic device storage.
The nonblocking reacquire helper without buffering is specified as having no effect on its context.

Virtio core exposes read only attributes for device identifier, vendor identifier, live status, modalias identity and feature bitstring with trailing newline, grouped in a null terminated table, using a container helper to obtain device state.

Device driver matching scans the driver identifier table until device equality or ANY wildcard plus vendor equality or ANY wildcard succeeds, returning success on first hit, and hotplug events export the same modalias identity.
Requesting confirmation for a feature bit absent from both standard and legacy driver tables terminates execution.

Configuration core gating updates the enabled flag and flushes any pending change notification while holding the device config lock with interrupts masked, and status updates read modify write through transport accessors in a context that may sleep.

Probing marks driver presence, intersects device and driver capabilities with version aware handling and legacy fallback, applies debug filtering while preserving transport bits, finalizes with optional validation and repeat finalization on change, completes the features handshake, invokes driver probe, ensures ready marking, runs optional scan and enables config notifications, marking failure on any error.

The features handshake requires modern version and platform access when memory access constraints apply, accepts legacy devices without further checks, otherwise asserts features accepted and fails when the device refuses.
Feature helpers prefer extended retrieval when available else expand legacy word, set bits only within bounds, combine device and driver sets by intersection, and clear debug filtered bits.
